description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (1.50 each), grants [DEF and MAG +30% (25s)] to all allies, grants [Synchro Mode], [Damage Cap +10000], [Double Crystarium Mode III (Holy, Dark)] and [Dawning Light Follow-Up] to the user

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands

description.name: Double Crystarium Mode III (Holy, Dark)
description.text: Grants [Attach Holy 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Dark 2 with Stacking] after using a Holy/Dark ability

description.name: Dawning Light Follow-Up
description.text: Casts Holy/Dark Dawning Light after casting two of Dark Marionette or Seraphic Phase if the triggering ability deals Holy/Dark damage
